hero.title: The CRM built for Agents
hero.lede: Humans should not be moving pipeline by hand. The first agentic CRM experience, with durable research agents that read your team's inbox, enrich companies and contacts, and create agentic workflows.

agent.title: Agents that automate your CRM.
agent.lede: Describe how your CRM should act. Create agents to automate every process.
agent.prompt: What should we get done, Lewis?
agent.composer: <text>Send a new message to</text><slack></slack><text>and ping</text><person></person><text>when a company misses their invoice deadline</text>
agent.actionChannel: <text>Create a</text><slack></slack><text>channel and invite the owner when a deal hits</text><stage></stage>
agent.actionPing: <lead>Ping</lead><person></person><text>when a contract has been out five days unsigned</text>
agent.actionRecheck: <text>Every Monday,</text><task>re-enrich contacts</task><text>that have not been contacted in</text><when>4 weeks</when>

enrichment.title: Records fill themselves in
enrichment.body: A new person on a thread becomes a contact, and their company arrives with its logo, industry and last activity already on it.

followUp.title: It books its own follow-ups
followUp.label: WHY
followUp.why: An agent that cannot say why it will be back in fourteen days does not have a reason, it has a default.

ask.title: Ask any record a question
ask.body: It reads their site and our own history with them, and shows its working.

meta.title: The CRM for agents
